title: Bridge hero
description: A calm centred hero on white: a soft sky-and-seafoam backdrop runs behind the header and melts into the page, then a huge regular-weight one-line headline, a quiet grey two-line mono subline and one small sky button, with a wide flat diagram strip underneath (tall and narrow on phones).
notes: two media slots: backdrop (a blurred photo fading into the page) and diagram (an animated embed, 1440×288 on desktop, ~390×480 on phones); both show placeholders when empty
set underHeader when it follows bridge-header so the backdrop runs behind the translucent header
name: bridge-hero

props.name: subtitle
props.description: the quiet mono line under it; a "\n" starts its second line on desktop

props.name: backdrop
props.description: a wide blurred photo behind the top of the hero, fading into the page; a soft wash when empty

props.name: diagram
props.description: the flow diagram under the button (wide strip on desktop, tall on phones); a flat surface when empty

props.name: underHeader
props.description: pull the hero up under a preceding bridge-header so its backdrop shows through the header
